lines.en: When I drift, the clouds scatter.
This huge body moves lightly.
Houses below look like blocks.

lines.zh: 我笑着飘过去，地上一片阴影。
lines.en: I float by smiling; a shadow covers the ground.
My belly jiggles; the air trembles.
No legs needed; I float.
The demon realm's wind pushes me along.
Floating and laughing all the way.
I reach out and touch a rooftop.
Slow drifting, and nothing stops it.
A long shadow trails behind me.

lines.zh: 我路过的地方，天都暗了。
lines.en: Where I pass, the sky darkens.
I hang in the air, legs swinging.
I laugh a while, then think of other things.
The colors of this world are amusing.
I scratch my belly.
Even a giant body must rest.
I hum a strange tune.
Below, little people run about.
I raise a hand and watch its shadow.
My eyes narrow to slits.

lines.zh: 我把气弹捏扁，又搓成圆的。
lines.en: I flatten a ki blast, then roll it round again.
I exhale and the clouds part.

lines.zh: 这身子，装得下很多邪念。
lines.en: This body holds plenty of wicked thoughts.
I tilt my head, thinking.
The quiet is more frightening.

lines.zh: 你这个小东西，抬头看我。
lines.en: Little thing, look up at me.
I have to look down to see you.
You don't run? Interesting.
My hand is bigger than your house.
I smile and show all my teeth.
Your ki is very, very small.
I reach out to pinch you.
Don't fear; I won't eat you yet.
You look up, and I laugh.
Creatures here are such fun.
I lean in; the wind arrives first.

lines.zh: 你的影子，被我的盖住了。
lines.en: Your shadow is swallowed by mine.

lines.zh: 我眨眨眼，天就闪了一下。
lines.en: I blink and the sky flickers.
Stand firm; don't get blown away.

lines.zh: 你这点气息，我拿捏得住。
lines.en: Your little ki fits in my grip.
Do you want to play with me?
My laughter makes the ground rumble.
So small — one bite and gone.
Pain? I haven't felt that in ages.

lines.zh: 这一拳打进厚厚的邪念里。
lines.en: That punch sinks into the thick mass of my evil.
I recoil, and the world shakes.
My laughter stops.
This body isn't iron either.
The pain bares my teeth.
You have some skill.
My blood falls like rain.
I look down at the small cut.
Food? I feed on chaos.
That won't fill a corner of me.

lines.zh: 我闻到的是恐惧，不是食物。
lines.en: I smell fear, not food.

lines.zh: 你把吃的举高？我随便拿。
lines.en: Holding it high? I'll just take it.
I'm not hungry; I want to play.
That's a grain of sand to me.
Your hand shakes — more fun.
My laugh doesn't mean I accept.
Big belly, strange appetite.
Put it away; don't waste it.
You hit me like hitting a mountain.
I float, and you still bump into me.
My belly is quite bouncy.
You bounce off like a pebble.
I look down and find it funny.
My hide feels cold, doesn't it?
I shift, and the wind sweeps you aside.
Do it again; I'm waiting.
A body this size finds few companions.
Even demon kin fear me.
I'm fine on my own.
You'll play with me? That's different.
I laugh and the world shakes.
These hands are too big to hold anyone.

lines.zh: 孤独这东西，我早习惯了。
lines.en: I'm used to loneliness.

lines.zh: 我把你放在肩上，可以吗？
lines.en: May I set you on my shoulder?
A voice to talk to eases the boredom.
One grab and a house crumbles.
This little thing is like a bean.
I pinch it between my fingers.
My hands are too big; accidents happen.

lines.zh: 两根指头把它凑到眼前。
lines.en: Two fingers bring it to my eye.
So many trinkets in this world.
I toss it and catch it.
Crushed it — a pity.
I close it in my palm and hide it.
I've marked you, little thing.

lines.zh: 你跑起来的样子，很好看。
lines.en: You look lovely when you run.
A giant eye fixed on you.
Where are the strong ones here?
You'll be my warm-up.
Your ki just flared.
I laugh — and this time it's not a joke.
My palm is already raised.

lines.zh: 我的大手垂下来，指缝里全是云。
lines.en: My huge hand lowers with clouds caught between the fingers.
This one, I take seriously.

lines.zh: 你逃到哪儿，我都跟得上。
lines.en: Wherever you flee, I keep up.

lines.zh: 地面上的东西，都在我眼里。
lines.en: Everything below is in my sight.

lines.zh: 我深吸一口气，云都动了。
lines.en: I inhale, and the clouds move.
Move aside; I'm coming down.

lines.zh: 这么大，也躲不开我的眼。
lines.en: Big or small, nothing escapes my eye.

lines.zh: 我笑着，等你自己撞上来。
lines.en: I laugh, waiting for you to blunder in.
Ki blasts gather in my palm.
One, two, many.
I'm not just brute force.
Can you dodge the first one?
I roar and the sky cracks.
Hear the great ape's roar.
Big body, but my strikes aren't slow.
I'm right above you.
The air feels heavier, doesn't it?
Run more and I'll slam down.

lines.zh: 一整片地，都在我影子下。
lines.en: A whole field lies in my shadow.
The blasts line up in a row.
Laughed enough; time to act.
I've long since fixed your position.
This blow won't miss.
My hand is a fist now.
The air presses downward.
One more second.
Demon fist — coming down.
This punch could level a hill.
I slam down and the ground dents.
You dodged? Not bad.
Combo — here's more.

lines.zh: 我的手扫过去，风都撕开了。
lines.en: My hand sweeps, tearing the wind.
Don't block it; you'll break.
A punch thrown laughing is worst.
That one was a courtesy.
Fast retreat — not fast enough.
I press you down; don't try to rise.
My fist misses and makes a crater.
Next punch uses both hands.
Don't scream; it's too quiet.
This blow will make you remember me.
Fun — again.

lines.zh: 天裂了一道口，我出来了。
lines.en: A rift opens and I come through.

lines.zh: 巨大的影子，先落到地上。
lines.en: My giant shadow lands first.
Laughing, I descend from the air.
The air here is so fresh.
I stretch and the clouds part.
Something this big squeezed through.
The little ones below all look up.
The demon king has come to play.
I laugh once as a greeting.
The ground sinks under me.
Don't run; I haven't looked yet.
This wicked aura blots the sky.
I land and dust shoots skyward.
Who's waiting? I've arrived.

lines.zh: 这么大的身体，动一下都费劲。
lines.en: A body this big is a chore to move.
I drift slowly and look around.
The air grows stifling around me.
Come, amuse me.

lines.zh: 火苗在我身上，像根火柴。
lines.en: Flame on me is a lit match.

lines.zh: 这么重摔下去，地都塌了。
lines.en: Falling this heavily collapses the ground.

lines.zh: 水灌进来，我呛得说不出话。
lines.en: Water pours in; I can't speak for choking.
The blast tips me backward.
An arrow sticks in my finger.

lines.zh: 那股力量，敢碰我的邪气。
lines.en: That power dares touch my malice.
This body gets savage when starving.

lines.zh: 雷劈在我头顶，麻了一下。
lines.en: Lightning hits my head and numbs me.

lines.zh: 这么大的我，也在往下掉。
lines.en: Even I fall through the void.
